_doc: Standard check framings. pos/target in BLENDER Z-up world metres. Camera = look_at(pos -> target), up = +Z. three.js equivalents: (x, z, -y). lens_mm is Blender focal length on a 36mm sensor; fov_deg is the matching three.js VERTICAL fov at 16:9 = 2*atan(10.125/lens_mm) (36 mm wide sensor; corrected 2026-09-28). Use these for every before/after render and every browser screenshot.
